In inactive regions sigma=r, recovering original AB2. This is causal and consistent as Delta tends to zero; no second-order/stability theorem is claimed at moving active faces. The missing projected-feedback-history term is fixed at the AB2 coefficient 1/2, with no parameter search.

Thus a second-order interval-average claim cannot hold generally while retaining current-state ZOH constraints. Blind post-QP AB2 is never actuated.
